walkthrough.title: Stop typing the same thing twice
walkthrough.summary: Create a snippet that expands from a keyword
walkthrough.body:
A snippet is a block of text you type constantly — your email address, a canned reply, a code block, your bank details — stored once and expanded by a short keyword, in any app.

A good first one is your email with the keyword `@@`.

## To complete the task

1. Run **Snippets** and create your first one.
2. Give it a keyword you would never type by accident.
3. Try the keyword in any other app.
